recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast outdoor portrait featuring a central figure in a bright yellow oversized suit against a deep cobalt blue sky and lush green grass, punctuated by geometric red objects.
coreVisualRelationships: Triadic color harmony between yellow suit, blue sky, and red accents
Vertical central figure bisecting a horizontal landscape
Surrealist placement of a red sphere and bin in a natural field
Hard-edged shadows indicating direct, high-noon sunlight
coreInvariants: Deep, saturated cobalt blue sky without clouds
Wide-angle perspective with a low horizon line

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body central figure, standing vertically, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright yellow suit acts as the primary focal point against the dark blue background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the head/sunglasses, moves down the yellow suit, then follows the red sphere in the foreground and the red bin in the mid-ground.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large expanse of solid blue sky in the upper half and green grass in the lower half creates a clean, uncluttered feel.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cobalt blue sky and emerald green grass provide the environmental base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant lemon yellow for the main subject's suit.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright primary red for the sphere, bin, and shirt collar.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extremely high saturation across all channels; deep values in the sky contrast with the high-value yellow suit.
paletteRestrictions: Strict adherence to primary triadic colors

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for maximum impact and brand clarity.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and sharp serifs of the era.
Provides the elegant, fashion-forward serif look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a wide-angle photo of a person in an oversized bright yellow suit standing in a green field under a cloudless deep blue sky. Place a red sphere in the bottom left foreground and a red rectangular bin in the mid-ground right. Use harsh, direct sunlight.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the title text in a bold, high-contrast red serif font at the top center. Use wide tracking and all-caps.

verificationChecks: Is the sky a solid, deep cobalt blue?
Is the suit a vibrant, non-muted yellow?
Are the red props clearly defined and geometric?
Is the text centered and rendered in a sharp serif?

mustRedesign: Avoid any clouds in the sky
Ensure the red of the text matches the red of the props
postGenerationChecks: Verify the text is a high-contrast serif
Ensure the horizon line is low and straight
Confirm the oversized fit of the suit
recipe.reuseFormula: Central figure in [Color A] suit + [Color B] environment + [Color C] geometric props + [Color C] wide-tracked serif typography.
